2. The opposite party No. 1 as pre-emptor filed a Miscellaneous Case No. 32 of 1995 on 20-8-1995 in the Court of the learned Assistant Judge, Shyamnagar, Satkhira, against the petitioner and opposite party Nos. 2-11 under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act for pre-emption of the case land transferred by a registered deed No. 1793 dated 23-4-1995. 

 4. Thereafter, the pre-emptee petitioner filed an application under Order VII, rule 11 read with section 151 of the Code of Civil Procedure for rejection of the plaint made under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act contending, inter alia, that the case kabala was registered under section 60 of the Registration Act on 28-9-1996 and in the deed, the consideration money was recorded as Taka 80,000, but the pre-emptor without making the statutory deposit of Taka 80,000 made an application for pre-emption and, as such, the application for pre-emption is liable to be rejected.
